description: What an amount in today's dollars will buy after a number of years at a given annual inflation rate, what today's basket will cost then, the cumulative price increase percent, and the purchasing power lost. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive inflation calculator calculator.

include_schedule.description: Set to true to include the purchasing power schedule in 5 year steps (or about 6 steps for longer horizons), matching the page table.

name: calculate_inflation
